verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships official client libraries in multiple languages, explicitly C++ and Python (an idiomatic Python API using native types), with code generators that produce typed message interfaces across languages. However, its own feature list says several capabilities are C++-only: intra-process communication, composition, managed lifecycles and content-filtered subscriptions. The evidence also never mentions TypeScript or Go SDKs. missing for 10: official TypeScript and Go SDKs, full feature parity across languages (Python lacks composition, lifecycle, intra-process and content filtering), independent corroboration of SDK quality.
